{{Top|leg}}
'''Processing furnaces''' were used by [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droids]] such as [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems']] [[I-C2 Civil-Industrial Droid/Legends|Civil-Industrial I-C2 droid]]. Raw material, such as damaged structures and debris, were disintegrated in the processing furnace by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] as it carried out its function.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
